title: OpenAI扩大AI普及：ChatGPT广告业务年化收入突破10亿美元
summary: OpenAI宣布其ChatGPT广告业务已达到10亿美元的年化收入运行率，并计划在全球范围内扩展。这一里程碑标志着OpenAI在商业化方面取得重大进展，同时通过免费和低成本选项，进一步推动AI技术的普及。广告收入的增长为OpenAI提供了可持续的资金来源，有助于降低对单一付费订阅模式的依赖，从而支持更广泛的用户群体访问先进的AI工具。此举不仅增强了OpenAI的财务稳定性，也体现了其致力于让AI技术惠及更多人的使命。通过广告模式，OpenAI能够在保持核心服务免费或低价的同时，实现商业可持续性，这为AI行业的商业模式创新提供了新思路。全球扩展意味着更多地区的用户将能够体验到ChatGPT等AI服务，进一步缩小数字鸿沟。总体而言，这一进展对AI技术的民主化具有积极意义，同时也为OpenAI未来的研发和运营提供了坚实的经济基础。
summary_en: OpenAI announced that its ChatGPT advertising business has reached an annualized revenue run rate of $1 billion and is expanding globally. This milestone marks significant commercial progress for OpenAI while supporting broader access to AI through free and affordable options. The ad revenue provides a sustainable funding source, reducing reliance on paid subscriptions and enabling wider access to advanced AI tools. This move enhances OpenAI's financial stability and reflects its mission to democratize AI. Global expansion will bring ChatGPT to more regions, bridging the digital divide. Overall, this development is positive for AI accessibility and provides a solid economic foundation for OpenAI's future research and operations.
